arm_motion.message: Lower elbow excursion describes a more fixed elbow during this swing. Mean flexion describes how bent it is. Neither establishes accuracy or better technique; a fixed bent elbow can also act as one rigid link.

bag_release_angle_deg.definition: Bag launch direction above horizontal, from the same fit.
bag_release_angle_deg.label: Release angle

bag_release_height_m.definition: Bag centre above the lowest foot point at release.
bag_release_height_m.label: Release height

bag_release_position_forward_arm_lengths.definition: How far in front of the throwing shoulder the bag leaves the hand.
bag_release_position_forward_arm_lengths.label: Release point

bag_release_speed_m_s.definition: Bag speed at release from a gravity-constrained fit of the first ~0.12 s of flight.
bag_release_speed_m_s.label: Release speed

elbow_angle_deg_at_release.definition: 2D projected shoulder–elbow–wrist angle; 180° = straight as seen by the camera.
elbow_angle_deg_at_release.label: Elbow angle at release

elbow_peak_extension_time_rel_release_ms.definition: When the elbow straightened fastest, relative to release.
elbow_peak_extension_time_rel_release_ms.label: Elbow extension timing

elbow_peak_extension_velocity_deg_s.definition: Fastest straightening of the 2D elbow angle in the forward swing.
elbow_peak_extension_velocity_deg_s.label: Peak elbow extension speed
reasons: Exploratory: a derivative of a 2D angle, sensitive to landmark noise.

swing_backswing_angle_deg.definition: Arm angle at the top of the backswing (negative = behind the body).
swing_backswing_angle_deg.label: Backswing

swing_forward_duration_s.definition: Top of the backswing to release.
swing_forward_duration_s.label: Forward swing time

swing_release_arm_angle_deg.definition: Shoulder-to-wrist line from straight down (0°) toward the board (90°).
swing_release_arm_angle_deg.label: Arm angle at release

swing_tempo_ratio.definition: Backswing time divided by forward-swing time.
swing_tempo_ratio.label: Tempo

trunk_inclination_deg_at_release.definition: Hip-midpoint to shoulder-midpoint line from vertical; positive = toward the board.
trunk_inclination_deg_at_release.label: Trunk lean at release

wrist_direction_at_release_deg.definition: Direction the wrist was moving at release, degrees above horizontal.
wrist_direction_at_release_deg.label: Hand direction at release

wrist_peak_speed_arm_lengths_s.definition: Fastest wrist speed between the top of the backswing and just after release.
wrist_peak_speed_arm_lengths_s.label: Peak wrist speed

wrist_peak_speed_time_rel_release_ms.definition: When the wrist was fastest, relative to release (negative = before release).
wrist_peak_speed_time_rel_release_ms.label: Peak wrist speed timing

wrist_speed_at_release_arm_lengths_s.definition: Speed of the throwing wrist at release (camera motion removed).
wrist_speed_at_release_arm_lengths_s.label: Wrist speed at release

coordinate_system.analysis: x toward target after reflection, y up
coordinate_system.body_normalization: throwing-shoulder-relative, divided by median projected upper-arm plus forearm length

gravity_scale.assumptions: Fixed level side camera; flight plane perpendicular to the optical axis; drag small relative to gravity.

flight.message: Confirm release and first contact in the video. No landing is inferred from tracker loss.
flight.timing_resolution_note: Two reviewed events: ±1 frame each gives a ±2/fps sensitivity bound, not a confidence interval.

quality.confidence_note: Model confidence is not a calibrated physical position or angle error.

bag.reason: No tracked flight: insufficient tracking quality.

calibration.note: A gravity scale assumes the flight plane is square to the camera; it is not a 3D calibration.

rules.bag: GOOD: bag found in ≥90% of flight frames, no gap longer than 3 frames, ≤10% of samples rejected as outliers, measurement noise σ ≤ 2 px. WARNING: ≥70% coverage and no gap longer than 6 frames. Otherwise POOR. No tracked flight is POOR.
rules.calibration: GOOD: an independent in-plane scale agrees with the flight's gravity scale within 10%. WARNING: a single scale source (gravity-only or measured-only). POOR: no physical scale (results stay in pixels / arm lengths).
rules.pose: GOOD: required landmarks usable in ≥90% of frames and ≥90% of frames within ±50 ms of release. WARNING: ≥70% and ≥60%. Otherwise POOR.
rules.release: GOOD: release confirmed by a person, or found automatically with the two release cues (first free-flight frame; backward flight meets the wrist) within 3 frames (50 ms at 60 fps), ≥6 launch-fit samples and launch-angle SE ≤ 3°. WARNING: automatic release with a window of 4–6 frames or failing a fit check. POOR: no confirmed release, or cues more than 6 frames apart.

warnings: Frame rate is below the recommended 60 fps; release timing is coarsely sampled.

Automatic bag tracking needs help: The refined path is not a plausible throw toward the target for this body scale. The path moves only 0.0 arm lengths toward the target; a throw needs at least 4. Select the bag near release to track it manually.
Body analysis completed; bag tracking has not started. Select the bag near release in the video, track it, and review its path to obtain release and flight measurements.
Fixed-camera geometry is unconfirmed. Projected bag velocity and angle describe image motion, including any camera motion; they are not world release conditions.
Release is an automatic candidate. Confirm visible separation before interpreting release measurements.
